name: See-eki! Bukkake Bokujou! ~Oshiru Ippai, Seirei-tachi o H ni Shiiku!~
original_name: セーエキ！ぶっかけ牧場！ ～お汁いっぱい、精霊達をHに飼イク！～
source:
Cum on down to the peaceful Bukkake Ranch, a good old farm out of the way from all the commotion and hubbub of the town, a place where you can relax and enjoy a quiet life with your four elementals: the salamander girl, Sara, the slime girl, Myil, the kobold, Korin, and the harpy, Papy. Life is good on the farm. That is, until the Demon Queen shows up your front lawn, demanding you create the legendary Slut’s Stone before she decides to wipe your farm off the map.

[From [url=http://blog.mangagamer.org/2013/02/15/announcements-from-katsucon-2/]MangaGamer blog[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到宁静的射精牧场。这座古朴农场远离城镇的喧嚣与纷扰，你可以在此放松身心，和4名元素精灵一同享受宁静生活：火蜥蜴少女莎拉、史莱姆少女米尔琪、狗头人科琳，以及鸟身女妖哈皮。农场里的日子惬意美好——直到魔王突然现身于你家门前，命令你打造传说中的“荡妇之石”。否则，她就会把整座牧场从地图上彻底抹去。

[引自[url=http://blog.mangagamer.org/2013/02/15/announcements-from-katsucon-2/]MangaGamer博客[/url]]
